item.title: Hawley Raises Concerns Over Chinese National Linked to Raided Las Vegas Biolab
item.description: Senator Josh Hawley on the suspected biolab that the FBI raided in Las Vegas: We don’t know if this property owner, who is a Chinese national, has ties to the Chinese government, and I think we’d better find out really quickly.

item.title: Trump Slams Fed Chair Powell Over $3–4B Renovation Costs
item.description: Trump on Jerome Powell: “I’m asking him, ‘Why are you spending almost $4B on a very small, little complex of buildings?’ … He’s renovating buildings for $3-$4B… They’re spending more money than [was spent on] any building ever built in history, per square foot.”

item.title: BREAKING: Klausenberger Rebbe Briefly Passes Out at Siyum HaRambam in Crown Heights.
item.description: BREAKING: The Klausenberger Rebbe passed out momentarily this evening while addressing a major Siyum HaRambam at the Armory in Crown Heights. The Rebbe was not transported to the hospital. Sources tell YWN that the Rebbe fasts during the weeks of “Shovavim”, and this incident is possibly related.

item.title: 🔥 UPDATE: Klausenberger Rebbe Apologizes After Slight Pass Out at Brooklyn Siyum
item.description: 🔥 UPDATE: The Klausenberger Rebbe apologizes for “scaring” thousands of people attending a major Siyum HaRambam in Brooklyn, after he briefly felt weak and partially passed out. The Rebbe eventually continued his Drasha. As YWN noted earlier, the Rebbe fasts during the weeks of “Shovavim”, and this incident is possibly related.
